data.name: ZS2
data.description: ZS2 Technologies is a Calgary-based building-materials manufacturer whose core business is low-carbon magnesium-cement products (TechBoard, TechPanel, TechClad, TechTile) sold to the North American construction industry. The company is also developing proprietary direct-air-capture technology to mineralize atmospheric CO2 into its cement, and in May 2025 launched its Gen 2 product line as the first large-scale domestic MgO-cement producer in North America.
